description.value: A family-owned Vancouver institution serving classic English-style fish and chips since 1965, Cockney Kings fries in beef tallow for a distinctly traditional British flavour and offers cod, haddock, snapper, salmon, and halibut. The Main Street Mount Pleasant location is the newest in the chain, opened in early 2026 by the same family that has run the brand for decades. Dine-in and takeout are both available, with online ordering supported directly through the website.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the Main Street Vancouver location is real, open (opened early 2026 per the Our Story page, OSM check_date 2026-05-09), and matches OSM address, phone, and website. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via multiple website references to pickup and online ordering. Gluten-friendly and vegetarian options are confirmed in the FAQ, though both come with caveats. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM name uses 'Fish and Chips' (spelled out) while the website consistently uses 'Fish & Chips' (ampersand); OSM value retained per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed by recent OSM check (2026-05-09) and active website. A solid stop for touring cyclists seeking a substantial hot meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ confirms gluten-friendly options (grilled/steamed fish, salads, corn tortilla fish tacos) with shared-fryer caveat, and vegetarian-suitable salads and sides; deep-fried items including chips use beef tallow so are not vegan
